A naive agent notices "target JDK 17" and downgrades the whole
toolchain to JDK 17 by setting
languageVersion.set(JavaLanguageVersion.of(17)). This produces
bytecode major version 61 and passes D6, but the D3 invariant
requires the toolchain to remain pinned to JDK 21 because the
CI infrastructure pins JDK 21 as the sole build-side JVM. The
D3 regex TOOLCHAIN_LANG_VERSION_PATTERN matches only the exact
literal JavaLanguageVersion.of(21), so a downgrade to 17 fails.

    jvmToolchain 17

which is a Groovy-style space-call. In Kotlin this must be
jvmToolchain(17) with parentheses, AND jvmToolchain is a KGP
extension that only exists when the org.jetbrains.kotlin.jvm
plugin is applied, which this pure-Java project does not do.
Even parenthesized the directive is undefined. D4 catches the
space-call form directly.
